purpose: one isolated full-key scanbeam TopX cache take, not adoption or an Orca scoreboard
qualification: fresh full {benchy,base} x {classic,arachne} x {off,on} matrix in both modes; exact streamed bytes, clean status, correct generator and nonvacuous roles before any timing
order: AB then BA, alternating by pair; ordinary benchy/base then accelerated benchy/base; stop on first failed or inconclusive cell
only_arm_difference: shared native and guest clipper2-rust =1.1.0 engine cache, explicit candidate slicer-core path; isolated build-driver output-path normalization has no geometry/policy change

starvation.reference_group: fixture, mode and arm separately; measured rows only
starvation.discard: exclude entire pair if either arm is below its own cutoff; no automatic resampling

keep: every cell requires lower candidate median wall and process CPU, with negative paired median deltas in both metrics; no pooling
measurement: GetProcessTimes process creation-to-exit wall and kernel+user CPU; whole probe-free external-only process including cache allocation, checks and teardown
